answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article published 2026-07-01 reporting an NN, Inc. announcement made in late June 2026; the article itself is a media summary, and the original NN press release was not supplied.
answer.note: Material source claim: NN, Inc. said in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and that 100% of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. NN also targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion. This is a company statement reported by a media outlet, so it supports the claim that NN has commercial activity tied to NVIDIA rack liquid cooling, but not a confirmed contract amount or the identity of the buyers. For NVDA, the item is a supply-chain lead: it points to an NVIDIA-linked liquid cooling supplier adding Asia capacity in 2026. Conditional on NN's statement being accurate and the awards being for NVIDIA-specified products, it would suggest NVIDIA's rack liquid cooling ecosystem is adding supplier capacity in 2026. It does not show NVIDIA buying from NN, and it does not establish any NVIDIA order size, backlog or revenue effect. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a third-party narrative and an unnamed analyst estimate, which are weak evidence and are not NVDA metrics. The Russell Microcap index removal concerns NN's trading and does not bear on NVIDIA.
limitations: The 100% pre-sold status and the multi-year awards are NN's own statement as reported by a media outlet; the award counterparties, volumes, prices and terms were not disclosed in the supplied material.
The supplied records do not name NVIDIA as the customer for the pre-sold capacity; the NVIDIA link comes from the headline and article framing about NVIDIA AI data center racks.
The US$80–US$90 million 2026 target is a company business target, not a reported result, and the supplied material gives no breakdown of how much of it is tied to NVIDIA.
The 2028 revenue and earnings projections come from a third-party narrative and unnamed analysts, so they are not evidence of NVIDIA demand or of NN's actual outlook.
The supplied material has no NN press release, filing or statement date beyond the media publication date of 2026-07-01 and the vague 'late June 2026' event time.
follow_up: Retrieve NN, Inc.'s original late-June 2026 press release or 8-K and check whether it names NVIDIA or only 'NVIDIA AI data center' end markets, and whether the awards are with NVIDIA or with intermediate rack or system makers.

Check NN's next quarterly filing or earnings call for the realized revenue from the Wuxi liquid cooling program and any stated customer concentration, to see whether the 2026 US$80–US$90 million target is being met.

Check NVIDIA's public supplier or partner disclosures and rack-level product announcements for any reference to NN or to Wuxi-sourced liquid cooling components, before treating NN as an NVIDIA supply-chain link.
